_meta.about: Texts of the Seedbox qBittorrent tile on the Unraid Dashboard (speeds, torrents, problems), its settings page and the Seedbox Tools page (Settings, Utilities): Find my torrent (files that are not seeded), Shape up (smaller or better releases through Radarr and Sonarr) and Season repacker (single episodes replaced by a season pack), with Activity on top. The Discord messages and the technical logs are not here. Terms: seed / seeding (sharing a finished torrent), tracker, release (a torrent Radarr or Sonarr offers), season pack, HDR / DV (Dolby Vision), hardlink, trash folder. Product names (Seedbox, Unraid, qBittorrent, Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, autobrr, Discord) stay as they are.

act.rm_confirm.text:
Remove the OLD torrent from qBittorrent and its whole folder?

The folder (video and everything with it: nfo, images, subtitles) goes to the trash folder and is deleted after the trash days (at once if they are 0). If another torrent seeds the same files, only the old torrent is removed. Do it only after you checked that the new version plays.

sp.confirm.text:
Replace the single episodes of this season with the season pack?

1. Sonarr downloads the pack (the episodes stay as they are meanwhile).
2. When it is 100% done and holds every episode you have, the season is unmonitored and its files are DELETED in Sonarr.
3. Sonarr imports the pack; then monitoring is restored and the single-episode torrents are moved to the trash folder.

It runs in the background; if something goes wrong before step 2 nothing is changed.

tp.about.a_seedbox_or_a.text: A seedbox, or a media server that seeds, only does its job if it seeds as many of its media files as possible. Content that nothing seeds is wasted: the ratio does not grow and the trackers may even drop you. The three tools work with Prowlarr, Radarr, Sonarr and qBittorrent.
tp.about.a_seedbox_or_a.note: text of the folded "What do the tools do?" part.

tp.about.find_my_torrent_looks.text: Find my torrent looks for torrents (through Prowlarr) for the files in your downloads folders that nothing is seeding. Shape up (formerly Update me) searches every big, old, seeded title in the background and offers a smaller release, a better HDR format or a higher resolution, replaced through Radarr or Sonarr after you approve. Season repacker replaces the single episodes of a finished season with the season pack, so that one torrent seeds the whole season (the torrents it adds get the seasonrepacker tag); it can also watch autobrr for new season packs.

u.with_offer.note: how many torrents have an offer ({n} shown in bold).

ws.btn.done.note: button: leaves the page (Unraid's usual word). Short.

ws.check.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

ws.col_bar.note: checkbox: show a progress bar under each torrent name.

ws.cols.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

ws.cols_hint.text: the torrent name column is always shown

ws.conn_state.note: small text next to the qBittorrent connection heading ({s} is qBittorrent's own state word: connected, firewalled, disconnected).

ws.e_auth.text: the username or password is wrong

ws.e_quote.text: double quotes are not allowed in the username or password

ws.h.rows_sub.note: small grey text next to the heading (the names of two parts of the tile).

ws.help.text: Stalled torrents are ignored: an idle seed that nobody downloads from is normal in qBittorrent. Errors, missing files, paused or stopped and queued torrents are listed under Needs attention; torrents that are moving, checking or allocating appear under In transfer. When the client is firewalled or disconnected, a single connection row is shown.
ws.help.note: grey paragraph at the bottom of the page.

ws.host.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

ws.host_hint.text: as seen from Unraid; 127.0.0.1 when qBittorrent runs in a container on this server with its port published

ws.pass_hint.text: the saved password is not sent to the page: leave it empty to keep it, type - to remove it; no double quotes

ws.password.note: grey text in the empty password field.

ws.rows.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

ws.rows_hint.text: more rows are counted in the band title

ws.saved.note: grey text in the empty password field: a password is saved.

ws.saved_msg.text: Saved. The dashboard picks it up within a few seconds.

ws.test_hint.text: tests the saved settings (Apply first after a change)
ws.test_hint.note: hint next to the test button.

ws.test_ok.note: result of a working connection test.

ws.testing.note: message next to the test button.

ws.tools_line.text: find torrents for files that are not seeded, replace content and big titles with better or smaller releases through Radarr and Sonarr, and repack seasons.
ws.tools_line.note: text after the "Seedbox Tools" link at the bottom of the page.

ws.url.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

ws.url_hint.text: the home icon of the tile opens this; empty = this server's address with the Web UI port
ws.url_hint.note: hint under the Web UI link field.

ws.user.note: label of a setting (left column, ends with a colon).

wse.replace.text: could not replace the settings file
wse.replace.note: reason after "Not saved:" on the Seedbox settings page.

wse.url.note: reason after "Not saved:" on the Seedbox settings page.

wse.write.text: could not write the settings file
wse.write.note: reason after "Not saved:" on the Seedbox settings page.

xfer.col_down.note: column header: download speed. Short (76 px).

xfer.col_eta.note: column header: estimated time left. Very short (50 px).

xfer.err_auth.note: message in the tile when the qBittorrent login fails.

xfer.more.note: link under the In transfer list (opens qBittorrent).

xfer.nothing.note: text in the In transfer box when nothing moves.

xfer.title.note: band title of the downloading, uploading and busy torrents (upper case on screen).

xfer.waiting.note: next to the bar of a torrent waiting to be moved by qBittorrent (moves run one by one). Short.

act.cancel.note: button on a running season pack replacement in Activity (only while the pack downloads). Short.

act.cancel_tip.text: Stop this replacement: the pack leaves Sonarr's queue and qBittorrent, your episodes stay as they are.

sp.cancel_confirm.text:
Cancel the season pack replacement of {n}?

The pack is removed from Sonarr's queue (blocklisted, so it is not grabbed again) and from qBittorrent with what it downloaded. Your episodes do not change.
sp.cancel_confirm.note: confirm box of the Cancel button; {n} = series and season, e.g. Slow Horses S05. Keep the empty line.

pk.cancelled.text: Cancelled: the pack is removed, your episodes did not change.
pk.cancelled.note: status of a cancelled season pack replacement (Activity, and the BoxBot Discord message).

pk.cancelled_noq.text: Cancelled: the pack was not in Sonarr's queue or in qBittorrent any more; your episodes did not change.
pk.cancelled_noq.note: status of a cancelled season pack replacement when there was nothing to remove.

e.sp_cx_busy.text: The minute check is running right now; try again in a minute.

e.sp_cx_gone.text: This replacement is not in the list any more.

e.sp_cx_late.text: Too late to cancel: the pack is downloaded and the episode files are being replaced.

e.sp_cx_sonarr.text: Sonarr did not remove the pack: {e}. Nothing changed.
e.sp_cx_sonarr.note: error of the Cancel button; {e} = Sonarr's error.

dc.have.note: Discord: title of the list of the episodes you have of the season, in the season pack message; {n} = episodes you have, {m} = aired, {s} = their size.

dc.eps_more.note: Discord: the last line when the episode list is cut; {n} = the episodes not listed.

dc.sp_cx_body.text: You cancelled it before anything was replaced: the pack left Sonarr's queue (blocklisted) and qBittorrent with what it downloaded. Your episodes did not change.

dc.pack.note: Discord field name: the season pack release.

e.sp_cx_over.note: error of the Cancel button when the job is done, stuck or failed already.
